text:
anya: quick async plan for phased enablement of the routing changes. aiming for a gradual slice roll today during the 16:00 PT window. outline below — comments/confirm who is on deploy + smoke checks.

mike: I can do the deploy and watch the first ramps. planning to trigger at 16:00 PT. will hand off to ops-oncall for the 50%+ steps.

lina: thanks — two quick asks: 1) list of cohorts + percent splits, 2) explicit smoke-checks so support can follow.

sean: cohorts I'm proposing: internal-internal (0.5%), staging (1%), small-beta (5%, US-west customers), regional-slices (20% us-west, 20% eu-central), then global 50% -> 100%. total rollout ~2 hours with 10–15m observation at each step.

anya: exactly. naming/flags: feature flag is `phased-enablement-v2` with `slice_id` tags. we'll toggle by slice id.

mike: deploy steps (short):
```
1) push build to prod nodes (non-disruptive)
2) enable slice internal-internal -> wait 10m smoke
3) enable staging -> wait 10m smoke
4) enable small-beta (5%) -> 15m smoke + perf check
5) open 20% regional slices -> 15m
6) 50% then 100% if green
```

lina: smoke-check checklist (soops):
- health endpoint: `GET /health` should be 200 for the new route (sample 50 reqs across nodes)
- p50/p95 latency: should not regress >20% relative to baseline dashboard
- error rate: <0.5% increase in 5m rolling
- token cost/per-request: sanity check (no huge anomaly)
- sample responses: run prompt set `smoke_prompt_v2` and verify output shape (no broken JSON)

ops-oncall: I'll take the watch from 16:30 PT. ping me in thread at the step boundaries. If latencies jump >20% or errors >0.5% rollback plan is to flip `phased-enablement-v2` off for the slice and then revert the rollout flag to previous default.

mike: rollback commands (pre-tested):
```
# disable slice only
redwoodctl feature toggle set phased-enablement-v2 --slice-id=small-beta --enabled=false
# global quick rollback
redwoodctl feature toggle set phased-enablement-v2 --enabled=false
```

sean: monitoring links:
- Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/rollouts/enablement-v2
- Logs search: https://logs.redwood.ai/q=phased-enablement-v2
- Alert: `rollout-latency-regress` -> threshold 20%

anya: please add a short note in the release ticket that we did the small-beta slice first and include the `smoke_prompt_v2` results. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2345

lina: copying support runbook snippet so they can triage quickly:
```
triage steps:
1) check dashboard for p95 spike
2) identify slice via `x-redwood-slice-id` header
3) if slice-specific, disable slice toggle
4) escalate to eng-releases if global
```

mike: I will post live updates in this thread during the rollout. planning target times: 16:00 enable internal, 16:10 staging, 16:25 small-beta, 16:45 regional 20s, 17:15 50%, 17:30 100% (approx).

ops-oncall: noted. I'll set a pager window 16:00-18:00 and leave a Slack status. if anything noisy I will call out `@mike @lina`.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by mike for 2026-03-17T16:00:00Z — job id: deploy-18020-01. Check `deploy-bot status deploy-18020-01` for live progress.

lina: final checklist before 16:00:
- [x] smoke prompt set updated
- [x] dashboards pinned to release ticket
- [x] rollback playbook in channel
- [x] ops-oncall confirmed

anya: thanks team — sounds good. if nothing blocks we'll proceed. :thumbsup: 

mike: starting the push in 20m, will update here when internal slice is live.

sean: one more note — ensure KV cache warmup for the new route; I've added a warmup job to run at enable time to avoid cold latency spikes.

ops-oncall: acknowledged, watching the warmup job as well.

mike: internal slice enabled at 16:00 PT — initial checks running

lina: saw `phased-enablement-v2` internal enabled; health 200 across nodes, p95 within baseline. continuing watch.

mike: staging enabled at 16:10 PT. no anomalies.

sean: small-beta 5% enabled at 16:25 PT. sampling outputs now. so far looks clean.

ops-oncall: all green through 17:00 PT — proceeding to regional slices as planned.

mike: regional 20% (us-west) and 20% (eu-central) enabled at 16:45 PT. monitoring closely.

lina: p95 see slight uptick (~10%) but within thresholds, error rate stable.

mike: moving to 50% at 17:15 PT.

ops-oncall: 50% stable. marking rollout as healthy. prepare for 100% at 17:30 PT.

mike: 100% enabled at 17:32 PT. promotion complete. final note: thanks everyone for the fast coordination. adding post-mortem-lite to the ticket for perf regressions if any show up in the next 24h.

anya: great work. closing the loop here.
